# Trough cross-section points

![Trough type 12 cross-section](data:image/png;base64,)

Local coordinate system: X=0 at centerline, Z=0 at bottom of trough outer box.
All dimensions derived from drawing geometry (see `trough_types.md`).

## Point index

| idx | name  | where |
|-----|-------|-------|
| 0   | W0    | outer top-left  (= cover bottom-left) |
| 1   | I0    | inner top-left  (wall_top_thick from W0) |
| 2   | I1    | inner slope-knee left  (where main slope meets 45° chamfer) |
| 3   | I2    | inner bottom-corner left  (inner_bot_half_w, bottom_wall_thick) |
| 4   | Ic    | inner center bottom  — trass / alignment point (X=0, Z=bottom_wall_thick) |
| 5   | I3    | inner bottom-corner right  (mirror of I2) |
| 6   | I4    | inner slope-knee right  (mirror of I1) |
| 7   | I5    | inner top-right  (mirror of I0) |
| 8   | W3    | outer top-right  (= cover bottom-right) |
| 9   | W2    | outer bottom-right |
| 10  | W1    | outer bottom-left |
| 11  | Cv_TR | cover top-right |
| 12  | Cv_TL | cover top-left |
| 13  | P0    | preparation top-left  (outer_half_w + overhang to the left) |
| 14  | P1    | preparation top-right |
| 15  | P2    | preparation bottom-right |
| 16  | P3    | preparation bottom-left |

## ASCII cross-section (Z up, X across)

```
Z
^
| Cv_TL━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━Cv_TR    Z = outer_height + cover_thick
|   |   cover                              |
|  W0━━I0━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━I5━━W3     Z = outer_height
|   |    \                              /   |
|   |     \  I1                    I4 /    |
|   |      \   \                  /  /     |
|   |       \   I2━━━━━Ic━━━━━I3   /      |     Z = bottom_wall_thick
|   |        |     inner bottom    |       |
|  W1━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━W2     Z = 0
| P0━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━P1   Z = 0  (top of preparation)
|  |           sand preparation              |
| P3━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━P2   Z = -prep_thick
|
+-----------------------------------------------------------> X
```

## Derived coordinates (half-widths, all in mm)

```
outer_half_w      = outer_width / 2
inner_top_half_w  = outer_half_w - wall_top_thick
inner_bot_half_w  = inner_bot_width / 2
```

Point X coordinates (symmetric about X=0):

| Point | X | Z |
|-------|---|---|
| W0, W1 (left outer) | -outer_half_w | outer_height / 0 |
| W2, W3 (right outer)| +outer_half_w | 0 / outer_height |
| I0 (inner top left) | -inner_top_half_w | outer_height |
| I2 (inner bot left) | -inner_bot_half_w | bottom_wall_thick |
| Ic (trass)          | 0 | bottom_wall_thick |
| I1 (knee left)      | between I0.x and I2.x | between outer_height and bottom_wall_thick |
| Cv_TL / Cv_TR       | ±outer_half_w | outer_height + cover_thick |
| P0 / P1 (prep top)  | ±(outer_half_w + 100) | 0 |
| P3 / P2 (prep bot)  | ±(outer_half_w + 100) | -prep_thick |

## Knee point (I1 / I4)

The inner wall has a 45° chamfer at the bottom corner. I1 is where the main slope
meets the chamfer. From geometry (measured, mm):

| Type | I1 offset from I0 (Δx, Δz) | chamfer size |
|------|---------------------------|--------------|
| 9    | (40, −460) | 50×50 |
| 10   | (50, −680) | 100×100 |
| 11   | (40, −360) | 100×100 |
| 12   | (100, −1130) | 150×150 |

Chamfer is always 45° (Δx = Δz between I1 and I2).

## Trass point (Ic)

Confirmed by CIRCLE on layer `0` in drawing. Sits at:
- X = 0 (centerline)
- Z = bottom_wall_thick (on the inner bottom surface, not the outer bottom)

This is the reference point that aligns with the Civil 3D alignment.

## Numeric values per type (mm)

| Parameter        | Тип 9 | Тип 10 | Тип 11 | Тип 12 |
|-----------------|------:|-------:|-------:|-------:|
| outer_half_w     |   290 |    590 |    890 |   1490 |
| inner_top_half_w |   240 |    530 |    810 |   1390 |
| inner_bot_half_w |   150 |    380 |    670 |   1140 |
| outer_height     |   580 |    880 |    580 |   1480 |
| bottom_wall_thick|    70 |    100 |    120 |    200 |
| cover_thick      |    80 |    120 |    200 |    250 |
| prep_thick       |   100 |    100 |    100 |    100 |
| prep_overhang    |   100 |    100 |    100 |    100 |
